sql:
SELECT
    toYear(s.DateKey) AS Year,
    toMonth(s.DateKey) AS Month,
    s.StoreKey,
    sum(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales,
    sum(s.SalesQuantity) AS TotalSalesQuantity,
    countIf(it.DownTime > 0) AS OutageEvents,
    sum(coalesce(it.DownTime, 0)) AS TotalDowntimeHours,
    round(
        corr(s.SalesAmount, coalesce(it.DownTime, 0))
        OVER (PARTITION BY s.StoreKey),
    4) AS SalesVsDowntimeCorr
FROM retail.FactSales s
LEFT JOIN retail.FactITSLA it
    ON s.StoreKey = it.StoreKey
    AND s.DateKey = it.DateKey
GROUP BY Year, Month, s.StoreKey
ORDER BY s.StoreKey, Year, Month;
